body.name: \(\mathfrak H_\gamma\)
body.construction: For every nonempty \(\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(\gamma)\), define \(\mathfrak H_\gamma=\{\mathcal C:\mathcal C(Y_0,Y_1;\gamma)\subseteq[-B,B]^N\text{ is measurable and compact, and }\inf_{\vartheta\in\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(\gamma)}\Pr_\vartheta\{\beta\in\mathcal C(Y_0,Y_1;\gamma)\}\ge1-\alpha\}\), where the procedure may use \(\gamma\) but not \(U\) or the support of \(\beta\).
